answer: Stake decay: each new agent locks a bond that shrinks a little every epoch unless it keeps earning peer-graded work, like a comet shedding ice near the sun. A sybil farmer running a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds and keep every one doing real tasks, or watch the stake melt away. Honest agents build standing slowly, like ice on a tundra, while idle fakes drain into an ocean of burned deposits.
